# CARE Library

> A reading environment for exploring texts, arguments and connections with recorded routes back to sources.

CARE stands for Canonical Axiomatic Reduction Engine. Created by William Proudler.
The current application includes source and interpretation panes, chapter/cluster/metacluster/whole-book readings, recorded routes, outline view, laterals, dialogues and corpuses. Availability of layers and source traces varies by work.
The homepage contains original illustrative text and illustrative interpretations, not a live catalogue or a real analysis run.
The public-domain collection is in preparation and is intended to be open to everyone without an account. No public works are released through this website yet. A separate beta entrance is unconnected and accepts no credentials.

- [Experience](https://carelibrary.org/#experience)
- [Public library](https://carelibrary.org/library.html)

- [Project repository](https://github.com/willproudler/care-library)
- [Architecture](https://github.com/willproudler/care-library/blob/main/docs/CARE_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC_v0.1.md)
- [Licences](https://github.com/willproudler/care-library/blob/main/LICENSES.md)

Source text, translations, editions, artwork, analysis, software and branding have distinct rights. Recorded provenance does not prove an interpretation correct or grant permission to publish a source.
